speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Morning prayer is done. I am not coming in to make a second glass of a Sunday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf is a penny, and it is a full thumb short of the notch, and I am not opening that argument on the porch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, and a thumb. I will not argue a thumb.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Look where the sword goes in before Sir John. That is the last Sunday you will see it carried before him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see it. I am not going up the lane. There is a letter to write, and it can sit in the coffer till the thirteenth.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then write it plain. Henley Street is not a supper near Paul's. If you have a story that wants clapping, do not send it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not send it. She will have the brook, and one small word, and no ride I cannot make.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Sir John does not speak, and I am not asking him to. God give you the day.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Come in. Gib has the settle, and Alse will not move him for a sermon that is already over.
